items.title: Discussion of Parcel Tax Survey Findings and Recommended Next Steps

publicComments.name: Jessica Shade
publicComments.summary: Expressed encouragement at increased poll support and equity of square-footage tax, noted parents are organized and ready to help, but cautioned the numbers are close to the 2/3 threshold and it will be a big lift.

publicComments.name: Carlo Contavalli
publicComments.summary: Urged the board to put the parcel tax on the ballot, arguing that with drastic budget cuts and no reliable state or federal funding, the community deserves the opportunity to vote on it.

publicComments.name: Brendan Matthews
publicComments.summary: Offered full support for the measure, particularly praising its progressive square-footage structure, and shared that his PTO at Adelante Selby is unanimous in support.

items.notes: Public hearing opened at approximately 8:11 PM (4193s) and closed at 8:12 PM (4264s) with no public speakers. Brief board discussion followed closure.

items.title: Approval of Consent Items
items.notes: All consent items approved as a bundle including: Board Meeting Minutes (June 11, 18, 25), BP/AR 5123, Roy Cloud field trip, YMCA agreement, Casa Circulo agreement, City of Redwood City (REACH) agreement, UC Regents agreement, Procare Therapy LVN agreements, Amergis agreement, Catalyst amendment, SCCOE MOU, SMCOE Teacher Induction, TCM Language Power ELD curriculum, SF State MOU, SJSU intern MOUs (x2), REACH University MOU, Notre Dame de Namur MOUs (x2), Personnel Report, NPS/NPA Master Contracts, Connect Facilities Use Agreement, food service bid extensions (Healthy Kids/Tasty Pizza, Allen Bros./Del Monte, Bonami Baking, Sysco Foods Grocery, Pacific Produce, Daylight Foods, Sysco Protein), Warrant Registers June and July 2025.
